subject: Public Comments
comment: I am all for freedom in America, after all that's what we all want, along with lower taxes. I am concerned with all of these electric vehicles and the onslaught of variety of vehicle (bike, scooters, motorcycle, golf carts) on the roads by a wide age groups. They are not following the NEW Utah State law. They are not safe for themselves or motorized registered vehicles they are supposedly Sharing the road with. Not all the scooters these kids are riding have lights and reflectors. These kids have not had the education to follow the rules of the road. The list of things these kids are doing are risking their safety. I'm all for technology. Let's use it safely.

subject: Public Comments
comment: When is the City going to update the online utility portal (Paymentus) to include payments NOT made through the actual portal? There is no payment history on the portal for residents who use their bank or credit union bill pay programs to pay their utility bills. It seems that this was an oversight at the time of the Paymentus implementation. This is something that can easily be corrected and would be very helpful to residents. Not everyone wants add credit card and actual checking account numbers online. It's a security issue.
